Containers.Name: Unspin
Containers.Description: Rudimentary hotfile tiering for Unraid. Promotes hot files from the array to cache/NVMe, cold ones are left to Unraid's mover. Shows which program, container, VM or SMB client spun up each disk. Never spins up a data disk itself.
Containers.ExtraSearchTerms: hotfile tiering spin up spindown wake disk
Containers.Overview:
Unspin runs a lightweight C++ daemon that monitors file accesses via fanotify on your array disks. When a file exceeds configurable access thresholds it gets promoted to your cache/NVMe pool.
Features: - Disk Spin-ups: shows which program, container, VM or SMB client spun up each disk, with daily counts and the latest spin-ups - Never spins up a data disk itself: a file whose disk was spun down is promoted once the disk spins up anyway, optionally waiting for parity too - Promote Now: promote a folder on request, right away or once its disks spin up anyway - Event-driven promotion, no polling or cron - Three promotion rules: small-file first-access, large-file streaming burst, periodic open detection - Safe hand-over: waits until a file is closed everywhere, so it is never lost, doubled or missing from the share - Mover/rsync-aware: pauses automatically during transfers; works with Mover Tuning (Pool Access Times) - Hot-tier fill guard, dry-run mode, exclude patterns, promotion stats - Named, stackable pause locks for backup scripts, optionally timed, usable via ssh - Live log viewer in the settings page
